## Nibiru
Type: celestial body
One-line: Anunnaki orbital constraint driver; departure clock that forces First Coming withdrawal.

## Crimson Citadel
Type: place/structure
One-line: Anunnaki command vessel; site of strategic assessments for First and Second Coming.

## Genesis Chambers
Type: place/system
One-line: Anunnaki creature-forge where suppression assets are “quarried” and matured.

## Sundering
Type: system/strategy
One-line: Long-horizon psychological weapon that degrades unity via implanted suspicions that feel self-generated.

## Gruulith
Type: engineered suppression species
One-line: Giant-derived stone combat tools with minimal cognition, perfect obedience, and terrain-camouflage infiltration tactics.

## Dregans
Type: engineered suppression species
One-line: Dragon-adjacent rage weapons; unstable obedience; sonic resonance attack tailored to shatter stone-flesh.

## Brajor
Type: engineered pressure species
One-line: Aquatic pod-based assets designed to pressure Tidecallers; show incomplete violence imperative and emergent curiosity.

## Kha
Type: ability/sense
One-line: Deep-earth consciousness channel used by Giants for perception, communion, and long-range messaging.

## Nephilim-class assets
Type: planned/summoned suppression force
One-line: Heavy suppression units intended to finish subjugation; later tied to “Nephilim Summoning” in resistance arc.

## Enlil / Eduhauana / Ninurta / Pazuzu / Korrhan / Saresh
Type: individuals
One-line: Command (Enlil, Eduhauana), bioengineering (Ninurta), Igigi bridge/awakening (Pazuzu), frontline leaders (Korrhan, Saresh).
